purpose: Read-only initial recent-work intake for the 2026-11-21 Zotero parity continuation.

capture_scope.fork_branches: All 25 branch names returned by paginated search_branches; cursor MjU returned an empty final page. Captured before root created codex/zotero-parity-2026-11-21.
capture_scope.fork_pull_requests: Latest 100 PRs, #206 through #305, returned by search_prs state=all, sort=updated, order=desc, topn=100. Each exact head SHA independently compared to frozen main.
capture_scope.open_fork_pull_requests: Separate state=open search returned no PRs.
capture_scope.upstream: GitHub repository metadata confirms parent MohammedAsaadAsaad/quds_office_suite; all four branch heads and all four PR heads separately compared to frozen fork main.

methods.branch_comparison: GitHub compare_commits(base=frozen main SHA, head=branch). All captured branch results were behind or identical, so merge_base_commit.sha is the exact compared branch head.
methods.pull_request_comparison: GitHub compare_commits(base=frozen main SHA, head=exact PR head SHA).
methods.upstream_collections: GitHub public REST /branches?per_page=100&page=1 and /pulls?state=all&per_page=100&page=1; both fewer than 100 rows.
methods.ci: No Actions, workflow, check or commit status endpoint was queried or awaited.

disposition: Start from frozen current main. All captured recent work is already present by ancestry; no branch replay or integration merge is required. Refresh before final publication to account for concurrent pushes.
